changelog.title: v44 — 2026-11-27 (nightly self-improve, Black Friday, thin news day; ADT's preliminary proxy shows Apollo introduced Thrive Holdings to ADT on Jul 23 and Josh Kushner signed the merger as CEO of Abode Parent; the 'USAID Files' release (Benz and Coristine announce it, State points to OMB; OCCRP, a party, grade I) draws a Shaheen-Meeks PII letter to Rubio and Acting Administrator Woolf, and Putin envoy Dmitriev amplifies Benz; Bessent's 'Have a wonderful winter' at Pezeshkian; Bloomberg's GB300 rack at an Alice Huang-linked Shanghai site (I); Leidos's Cloud One contract and the reported breach; EFTA II petition at 218 and Massie's 'vote after recess'; join index; ~11:45 PM ET Nov 27 – ~12:25 AM ET Nov 28)
changelog.html:
Counts: nodes 379 -> 385 (+6: Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (SFRC ranking member), Mike Benz (Foundation for Freedom Online), USAID (remnant; OMB jurisdiction), Masoud Pezeshkian (Iran president), Leidos, US Air Force (Dept. of the Air Force)). Sourced (register) edges 501 -> 509 (+8): wave v44 in edges.jsonl, filed as grokbot-2026-11-27-powermap-v44-{V|I}-{slug} (theatre=powermap, origin=map, spine=grokbot) via file.py --file. 6 V, 2 I; SAID 3, BOTH 4, DONE 1. Total edges 523 -> 531. Key chains +2 (137 -> 139). Sequence index 51 -> 52 ties (the Apollo tie carries a sequence-only clause on the Jul 29 278-T sale). Pushback index 56 -> 58. Attribution: 7 of the 8 new ties on_record, 1 mixed (Leidos: contract on record, breach anonymous). Follow-through pairs 23 -> 24. Oversight asks 12 -> 13 (Shaheen-Meeks letter). Open questions 109 -> 112. Re-checks: 8 edges (row grokbot-2026-11-27-V-powermap-v44-recheck-roles). Status set: thrive-holdings-adt-acquisition-2026 pending (PREM14A Nov 20; go-shop still running at this pass, ends 11:59 PM NY Nov 28; no ADT filing after Nov 20 on EDGAR; Excluded Party talks to Dec 8); trump-names-davies-national-cyber-director-wh-2026-11-20, trump-nominates-oneill-mdnc-judge-2026-11-24 pending (WH Nominations page still latest Nov 16); cornyn-blocks-gaiser-wh-vets-fahey-2026-11-23 changed (Reuters re-run Nov 27: Trump 'taking steps to replace' Gaiser; no transmittal); tim-scott-huang-senate-banking-dec3-2026 pending, now on the committee's own hearing page (Dec 3, 10:00 AM, Dirksen 106, open, hybrid, sole witness Huang); house-chairs-huang-briefing-2026-11 pending (Dec 1 still set; Nvidia's Dec 1 GTC DC session lists four other executives); sec-nvidia-disclosure-probe-2026-11 pending (no Nvidia 8-K after Nov 23); garcia-oversight-dems-vance-epstein-letter-2026-11-18 pending (due Dec 2). Retired: 0.

Why: (1) ADT Inc. PREM14A filed Nov 20 2026 (accession 0001628280-26-075319, opened on EDGAR): 'Background of the Merger' says ADT's CEO DeVries and CFO Likosar 'were introduced to representatives of Thrive Holdings by a representative of Apollo' on July 23, 2026; Apollo signed an NDA as 'a potential source of debt financing' (Aug 3) and sent a 'highly confident' letter for up to $11 billion (Sep 22); Apollo affiliates sold their last ADT equity in May 2026. The annexed merger agreement is signed for Abode Parent, LLC and Abode Merger Sub by 'Joshua Kushner, Chief Executive Officer'. The register's v23 tie dates the President's managed-account ADT sale to Jul 29 (OGE 278-T), six days after the introduction: sequence only, no link shown, and a sale before a premium bid is no sign of foreknowledge. (2) SFRC minority release, published Nov 26 (opened): Shaheen and Meeks wrote Rubio and Acting USAID Administrator Bill Woolf on Nov 25 that the USAID.gov files 'include Personally Identifiable Information' 'in likely contravention of federal law', and asked what Privacy Act review was done. (3) OCCRP, Nov 26 (opened): Mike Benz 'appears to have orchestrated' the release and announced it on X; reportedly a special government employee since December 2025; State told OCCRP it 'welcomes this release' and that OMB 'now exercises executive and policy jurisdiction over the remaining elements of USAID'. NY Post (Nov 25, opened): DOGE alumnus Edward Coristine announced the files on X. OCCRP is a former grantee and a plaintiff, so the tie is I. (4) Dmitriev's two X posts (Nov 27, 3:10 PM and 3:32 PM EST per xtime.py, opened via the fxtwitter API) quote Benz's '$32 million' line against OCCRP and praise the 'USAID Files' ('WWG1WGA'); the figure is Benz's graphic, not checked. The private account he replied to is not named. (5) Official @SecScottBessent, Nov 27 2:01 PM EST (xtime.py; opened): 'Good job, guys. Have a wonderful winter.', quoting the Washington Post's video of Pezeshkian in an unheated office. (6) Bloomberg via Investing.com (Nov 27, opened): Chinese loan-collateral filings list a Gigabyte-built GB300 NVL72 rack at the Yangtze River Delta Project in Shanghai, linked to Alice Huang; Shanghai Kezhan is 83.3% owned by NeXPower Japan (Caixin: controlled by Alice Huang); Nvidia did not respond; Bloomberg lacks proof Megaspeed sent it.
